behaviour: Repair the styled-range test file: commit the seed to history, undo twice with an isDeleted guard in the undo/redo test, and cast the two setSelectedElements arguments to NonDeletedExcalidrawElement.
rules: 1. Change only the six sites; every other line, including the other seven test cases and every existing expect, stays byte-for-byte as it is.
2. No new test case, no it.skip/it.todo, no removed expect; the post-undo range assertion stays exact (no bound, no tautology).
3. CaptureUpdateAction is a value import from "@excalidraw/element"; NonDeletedExcalidrawElement is a type import from "@excalidraw/element/types".
4. Output must be prettier-clean at 80 columns, as `yarn fix` would leave it.

sites.rule: Becomes the single line: import { CaptureUpdateAction, newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
Becomes a multi-line `import type {` statement naming ExcalidrawTextElement then NonDeletedExcalidrawElement, one per line with trailing commas, closing with `} from "@excalidraw/element/types";`.
Becomes API.setSelectedElements([text as NonDeletedExcalidrawElement]); at the same two-space indent, nothing else changed.

Becomes the only seed call, at the same four-space indent, printed as prettier does: API.updateScene({ then `elements: [text],` and `captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,` one per line, then });

At the same four-space indent, becomes in order: a two-line // comment saying the first undo reverts the selection-only appState entry Keyboard.exitTextEditor pushes and the second reverts the styleRanges update; Keyboard.undo(); Keyboard.undo(); expect(getText(text.id).isDeleted).toBe(false); the existing range assertion on lines 173-175 follows unchanged.
Becomes API.setSelectedElements([styled as NonDeletedExcalidrawElement]); at the same four-space indent; line 194 (setSelectedElements([plain])) is not touched.

tests.expect: range present before undo; after two undos isDeleted is false and no red range remains; after redo the range [12,19,red] is back
